name: succinate dehydrogenase complex iron sulfur subunit B

function.text: SDHB encodes succinate dehydrogenase [ubiquinone] iron-sulfur subunit, mitochondrial. Annotated molecular activities include electron transfer activity and succinate dehydrogenase (quinone) activity. It participates in aerobic respiration and succinate metabolic process.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to hereditary pheochromocytoma-paraganglioma (autosomal dominant); mitochondrial disease (autosomal recessive). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Paraganglioma; SDH-deficient renal cell carcinoma; Succinate dehydrogenase (SDH)-deficient gastrointestinal stromal tumor. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
